output_list.code: function mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) onlyOwner public {            balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount;            totalSupply += mintedAmount;            Transfer(0, this, mintedAmount);            Transfer(this, target, mintedAmount);        }
